headline: 950 children dead as measles death toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Seven more children died within 24 hours, according to the latest report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Seven children with measles-like symptoms died within 24 hours, from Tuesday morning to Wednesday morning, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

headline_marked: Online gambling 'super agent' [[arrested by RAB in Dhaka]]
headline: Online gambling 'super agent' arrested by RAB in Dhaka
summary: Ahidur Rahman, 43, allegedly used fake social media accounts to lure people into international gambling sites, buying land and cars with the proceeds.
details: The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB-3) arrested Ahidur Rahman, 43, from the Shahjahanpur area of Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon.
According to RAB, Rahman acted as an 'admin' and 'super agent' for several international online gambling sites, luring users via social media to steal millions of taka.
The suspect allegedly used fake Facebook and WhatsApp accounts to attract victims and promote banned international gambling platforms.
RAB seized two smartphones, 131,000 taka in MFS accounts, 105,000 taka in cash, two SIM cards, and a motorcycle from his possession.
Investigation of his phone records revealed evidence of illegal transactions and communications with individuals both locally and domestically for gambling site promotion.
RAB believes 10 to 12 other people are involved in this racket, who used electronic devices to manage agents and sell gambling site currency for money.
The suspect and his associates allegedly used the illegal earnings to acquire land and vehicles across the country.
Legal action is being taken against Ahidur Rahman, and RAB is working to arrest the other members of the the gambling ring.
caption:
